remarks: **Turnkey Restaurant Opportunity**  Commercial Condominium "For Sale" at $1,350,000 or "For Lease" at $9,800/month NNN. This fully equipped turnkey restaurant is located in a highly affluent area on the Norwalk-Wilton town line. Less than 1 mile from Merritt 7, the largest office complex in Norwalk, CT.    **This is not a business sale**  This commercial condominium is located on busy Rt. 7 (Main Avenue) with over 34,300 vehicle passing by this property each day. Take advantage of this immediate opportunity to buy or lease in this established retail strip center with many nearby retailers and offices including Walmart, LA Fitness, TJ Maxx, Starbucks, and CVS.   Known as "Town Line Center", this location includes highly visible pylon signage along a busy state road and has abundant onsite parking for staff and customers.   Sale or Lease includes all restaurant furnishings with a fully equipped kitchen. This location includes 3,519 sf of beautifully finished restaurant space on the ground level plus an additional fully built out 2898 sf on the lower level.
